chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
The injuries of slaves are assessed in accordance with the injuries of free persons in terms of value.

key_terms.الثَّمَنِ: monetary value or price in which the compensation is reckoned
key_terms.الْأَحْرَارِ: free persons whose injury rulings serve as the basis of comparison
key_terms.الْعَبِيدِ: slaves; legally unfree persons discussed in the ruling
key_terms.جِرَاحَاتُ: injuries or wounds that are subject to legal assessment

ai.seo_question: How are injuries to slaves legally assessed in comparison to injuries to free persons in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the assessment of injuries inflicted upon slaves. It states that such injuries are evaluated according to the same pattern as injuries to free persons, with compensation considered in terms of monetary value.
